propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts (transcript findings doc, transcript driver, and matrix driver) were committed on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx but not present on main, making the ticket unverifiable against main until landed

The diagnostic artifacts follow an established convention in docs/experiments/ (paired live-diagnostic driver + findings write-up) and are reusable via parameterization over ticket/ref/step-floor/trial-count rather than throwaway

The completion-verifier runaway loop continues to occur on current main at elevated request counts (66+ requests observed), despite the runaway guard backstop working; the underlying loop is not fixed
The verifier overspends budget relative to actual convergence need (8-criterion ticket receives ~10x required budget at _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 vs ~6 steps/criterion observed)
Runaway loop clustering on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets with multi-file acceptance criteria suggests context pre-selection as root cause rather than guard-level fix
